description: Live-shaped br doctor --json payload for the metadata-message-only contradiction: br sync --status reports dirty_count 0 / jsonl_newer false / db_newer false, doctor reports ok=true with clean parse, integrity, and counts, yet sync.metadata still carries the prose message 'External changes pending import'. The claim gate must keep trackerAuthoritative=true, emit trackerHealth=doctor_metadata_message_only, and surface the contradiction as the warning-severity beads_tracker_metadata_drift degraded code instead of beads_tracker_not_authoritative.
